summary_1line: Humiliated after being freed by the Pandavas, Duryodhana laments his shame, resolves to starve to death, and offers the throne to Dussasana while Karna urges him to endure.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bound and disgraced, Duryodhana stands before Yudhishthira after being delivered by the Gandharvas while the Pandavas and royal women look on.
Dussasana collapses at Duryodhana’s feet in tears, begging him not to abandon the throne.
Karna steps forward solemnly to console the weeping Kuru brothers, urging Duryodhana to rise and return to his city.
